{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer in charcoal grey with a slightly padded shoulder, notch lapels, and single-button closure crafted from a wool blend containing fine polyester for autumn warmth.
Tailored trousers in matching charcoal grey featuring a high waist, straight leg, and side pockets made from the same durable wool-polyester mixture.
A crisp white silk-blend blouse with a point collar and French cuffs worn underneath to add breathability and a clean base layer.
Closed-toe pumps in black leather with a moderate heel height that complements the professional silhouette while ensuring comfort throughout the day.
Gold hoop earrings with a polished finish that catch the light without being excessive, paired with a slim silver watch featuring a dark face for a touch of sophistication.
This outfit works perfectly for an autumn office day as it adheres to the "smart" dress code by combining a structured blazer and tailored trousers that convey professionalism. The charcoal grey palette coordinates beautifully with her warm skin tones and hair colors, creating a balanced and polished look. The inclusion of a silk blouse adds necessary breathability for indoor environments while the wool blend outer layers provide the essential warmth needed during the fall season."}
